description: Control who can open a site, Google Docs style. generalAccess: 'restricted' (only named people), 'link' (anyone with the unguessable link), 'request' (anyone can ask; you approve), 'org' (members of your Neuron org), 'domain' (verified emails on allowedDomains), 'public' (anyone — requires confirmPublic). Optionally add a password (applies to everyone but owners), add/remove named people (email / WhatsApp number / Neuron user id, with optional expiry), rotate the link (old link dies instantly), set a link expiry, or pause the site. Every change logs current viewers out within ~15 seconds.

linkExpiresAt.description: ISO datetime when the link stops working, or null

password.description: Set (8–128 chars) or null to remove. Changing it logs everyone out.

paused.description: Pause: everyone but owners sees 'not available'. Files are kept.

peopleExpireAt.description: ISO datetime when access for addPeople ends

name: neuron_sites_set_access
title: Set Site Access
